en.headline: Anita Mui statue returns to Avenue of Stars after restoration
en.dek: The bronze figure of the late singer was re-unveiled on Tuesday following three weeks of conservation work on the Tsim Sha Tsui waterfront.
body: The bronze statue of late singer and actress Anita Mui at the Avenue of Stars in Tsim Sha Tsui was re-unveiled on Tuesday after a three-week restoration.

Conservation work ran from 3 to 21 September to address corrosion caused by the seaside location. Fan group organisers and friends of the star attended the reopening ceremony. The statue, first installed in 2014 and funded by supporters, stands about two metres tall and carries the inscription “Hong Kong’s Daughter Anita Mui” in calligraphy by Andy Lau.
Visitors can again view the figure on the waterfront promenade. Organisers said the restoration preserved the original sculpture while protecting it against the humid coastal environment.

zh.headline: 梅艷芳星光大道銅像修復後重新揭幕
zh.dek: 尖沙咀星光大道銅像完成約三星期修復工程後於周二重新亮相，歌迷及圈中好友出席揭幕。
body: 已故歌手梅艷芳位於尖沙咀星光大道的銅像，經約三星期修復後於周二重新揭幕。
工程由9月3日至21日進行，主要處理海邊潮濕環境引致的腐蝕。歌迷組織及圈中好友出席重啟儀式。銅像於2014年豎立，由歌迷籌款鑄造，高約兩米，底座刻有劉德華題字「香港女兒梅艷芳」。
市民及遊客可再次在海傍欣賞銅像。主辦單位表示修復保留原貌，同時加強保護以應付沿海濕度。
